messages.subject: Enterprise quote
messages.text:
Shlomi,

I looked at the Enterprise quote. Honestly the price is a problem for us, it's well above what we pay for our current tool. Our procurement team will need three quotes before anything moves.

I'll get you our security questionnaire by Friday 16 October.

Bill Lumbergh
Director of IT

messages.subject: Re: Enterprise quote
messages.text:
Hi, Peter here, I run the support desk and would be the main user. My team wastes hours a day re-keying tickets between systems. I'd love to see this happen but Bill owns the budget.

Peter
